composition.serve_who: Sheet GMMS 108'-115 "AFT SERVICE PUMPS" is a relay/terminal wiring diagram covering seven DC 24V pump/sender loads fed from the DC MAIN PANEL breakers Q1–Q6 and routed through a PC CARD terminal/relay interface (terminals 76–105) that reports run/alarm status to a monitoring loom and to remote panel terminals (T/S F, cross-ref DWG-120). By load name the sheet serves: AFT GREY WATER PUMP + its level sender (530-grey-water-pumps); PORT AFT GUEST GREY SUMP and STBD AFT GUEST GREY SUMP pumps (530-sump-pumps); FWD CREW HEAD SUMP PUMP and AFT CREW HEAD SUMP PUMP (530-sump-pumps); AFT A/C SUMP PUMP (530-sump-pumps); plus a bank of status-only taps for other sumps/bilges (MAST BILGE, ENGINE ROOM BILGE, OWNERS GREY SUMP, FWD GUEST GREY SUMP) that are only monitored here, not switched — their actual pump circuits live on other sheets. FWD GREY WATER (sender + S18 AUTO leg) is also referenced but its pump circuit itself is on the FWD side (see DWG cross-ref, register maps FWD GREY WATER PUMP to 530-grey-water-pumps too).

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Load named 'AFT GREY WATER P.' fed by breaker Q1 10A, matches engineer mapping AFT GREY WATER PUMP -> 530-grey-water-pumps. Sender is drawn on the same load line (AFT GREY WATER SENDER) feeding a level gauge via SWB02/AFT -XA70 terminals 07(+)/08(-).

functions.label: AFT grey water tank pump — run/status control loop
functions.sheet_region: top-left (DC MAIN PANEL Q1 column) through PC CARD terminals 76-81 to AFT GREY WATER pump on right edge
functions.what_it_does: Runs the AFT grey water discharge pump; the circuit is switched via a manual switch after breaker Q1 and relay Re12, with RUN and ALARM status reported through PC CARD terminals 76-81 to the monitoring loom (XA61 pins 08/10/12).

flow_scenarios.path: DC MAIN PANEL Q1 (10A) -> manual switch -> Re12 relay contact -> pump positive; pump negative not traced on this sheet (runs to ground/negative bus off-sheet)

Re12 coil circuit -> terminal 76 (T/S C) = RUN status line to PC CARD; terminal 77 (fused) also on RUN line; terminals 78/79 -> XA61 pin 10 (status out); terminal 80 <- XA61 pin 12; terminal 81 -> XA61 pin 08 (ALARM status out to monitoring)

key_components: Relay Re12 (run control relay — NC/NO exact load-contact assignment not confirmed, see uncertainty)
RUN/ALARM status taps to XA61 (monitoring loom, cross-reference)
functions.dry_data: 24V DC, breaker Q1 10A, relay Re12, fused terminal 77

functions.label: AFT grey water tank level sender
functions.sheet_region: mid-upper right, 'AFT GREY WATER SENDER' resistive symbol
functions.what_it_does: Provides tank-level signal for the AFT grey water tank to the main-panel gauge via SWB02/AFT terminal block XA70 pins 07(+)/08(-).

flow_scenarios.path: SWB02/AFT -XA70 07(+) and -XA70 08(-) -> horizontal supply line -> AFT GREY WATER SENDER (variable resistor) -> level gauge on MAIN PANEL

key_components: AFT GREY WATER SENDER (resistive level sender)

functions.label: Fwd crew head sump pump
functions.sheet_region: left column Q4 10A row / relay Re13 / terminals 86-88 / BY-PASS and REED SUMP SW on right
functions.what_it_does: Automatically pumps out the forward crew head grey sump, normally driven by a reed/float switch (REED SUMP SW.) with a manual BY-PASS switch in series/parallel for override; relay Re13 provides the run control.

flow_scenarios.path: DC MAIN PANEL Q4 (10A) -> local switch -> Re13 coil energised (closing/opening contact per NC/NO — not confirmed) -> terminal block 86/87/88 (fused) -> load to pump via BY-PASS switch left open -> REED SUMP SW. (drawn NC per symbol but wiring measurement shows NO — CONFLICT, flagged) closes on rising sump level -> pump run
same supply path -> BY-PASS switch closed manually -> bypasses REED SUMP SW. -> pump runs continuously regardless of float state
terminal 86/87/88 -> PC CARD RUN indicator line

key_components: Relay Re13 (coil energising side traced only to Q4/switch — POSITIVE feed side of coil not traced on this sheet)
REED SUMP SW. (float/reed switch — NC/NO reading in conflict between symbol and measured wiring)
functions.dry_data: 24V DC, breaker Q4 10A, relay Re13, fused terminals 86/87/88

functions.what_it_does: Automatically pumps out the aft crew head grey sump, normally driven by a reed/float switch (REED SUMP SW.) with a manual BY-PASS switch override; relay Re14 provides the run control.

flow_scenarios.path: DC MAIN PANEL Q5 (10A) -> local switch -> Re14 coil energised -> terminal block 89/90/91 (fused) -> load to pump via BY-PASS switch left open -> REED SUMP SW. (drawn NC, wiring measured NO — CONFLICT) closes on rising sump level -> pump run
same supply path -> BY-PASS switch closed manually -> bypasses REED SUMP SW. -> pump runs continuously
terminal 89/90/91 -> PC CARD RUN indicator line

key_components: Relay Re14 (POSITIVE feed side of coil not traced on this sheet)
REED SUMP SW. (NC/NO conflict, see uncertainty)

functions.label: Aft A/C sump pump — run/alarm control and status collection hub
functions.sheet_region: left column Q6 20A row, through PC CARD terminals 92-101, S18 selector switch, to pump lower-right with 1A fuse
functions.what_it_does: Pumps out the aft air-conditioning condensate sump; the PC CARD terminal block also serves as the collection point for STATUS-ONLY taps from other bilge/sump circuits (MAST BILGE, ENGINE ROOM BILGE, OWNERS GREY SUMP, FWD GUEST GREY SUMP) reporting into the same alarm loom — those other circuits are NOT switched from this breaker, only monitored here.

flow_scenarios.path: DC MAIN PANEL Q6 (20A) -> terminal 97 -> S18 selector switch AUTO position -> terminal 99 -> pump switch -> 1A fuse -> AFT A/C SUMP PUMP positive; pump negative return not traced on this sheet
Q6 -> terminal 97/98 -> S18 ON position -> directly energises pump circuit bypassing auto float control
S18 open — no supply reaches the pump switch

ALARM lamp on PC CARD <- taps 92 (MAST BILGE), 93 (ENGINE ROOM BILGE), 94 (OWNERS GREY SUMP), 95 (FWD GUEST GREY SUMP), 96 (AFT A/C SUMP, tied via T/S E-19/20), plus BACKUP EM POWER / GMDSS BACKUP tap and XA61-08 monitoring tap — all status-only inputs into a shared alarm indicator, not control commands (no coil found on these nets)

key_components: Selector switch S18 (ON/OFF/AUTO — measured NO at multiple positions)
ALARM lamp (shared status indicator for multiple bilge/sump circuits)
Status taps 92-96 (fused terminal 96 group tied to T/S E-19/20 backup/GMDSS power monitoring)
functions.dry_data: 24V DC, breaker Q6 20A, selector switch S18, 1A fuse; status taps 92-96 to shared ALARM lamp

functions.label: Fwd grey water tank level sender (reference)
functions.sheet_region: lower-right, 'FWD GREY WATER SENDER' resistive symbol below S18 block
functions.what_it_does: Provides tank-level signal for the FWD grey water tank via SWB01/FWD terminal block XA30 pins 01(+)/02(-); the FWD grey water pump's own switching circuit is not drawn on this sheet (this sheet is titled AFT SERVICE PUMPS).

flow_scenarios.path: SWB01/FWD -XA30 01(+) and -XA30 02(-) -> horizontal supply line -> FWD GREY WATER SENDER (variable resistor) -> level gauge on MAIN PANEL

key_components: FWD GREY WATER SENDER (resistive level sender)

infrastructure.system_name: PC CARD terminal/relay interface (aft service pumps)
facts: Dotted-boundary 'PC CARD' block houses numbered terminals 76-105 that interface breaker/relay pump circuits to RUN indicator lamps, an ALARM lamp, and the vessel monitoring loom (XA61 taps).
Terminal 105 is a fused terminal (EMERGENCY LTS SW Link, pin 12).
T/S E terminal 57 relay coil (EMERGENCY LTS SW Link) reads NO on measured wiring — feeds toward T/S F / DWG-120 (cross-reference).
T/S B terminals 19/20 are explicitly marked 'not used' (spare).

infrastructure.system_name: Remote/monitoring terminal strip T/S F (see DWG-120)
facts: T/S F terminals 19-24 continue via multi-core cable MU4-12 to another sheet (cross-reference DWG-120); terminals 23/24 marked 'not used' (spare); terminal 22 = EMERGENCY LTS SW.

good_to_have: Exact 1A fuse ratings at each sump pump inlet are printed on the drawing — value confirmed as 1A, part number not needed
Fused terminals 77, 83, 85, 87, 90, 91, 105 are built-in replaceable fuses — troubleshooting culprits, exact fuse rating read at inspection if needed
Q1-Q6 breaker ratings all legible on sheet (10A/10A/20A/20A/10A/10A/20A)
uncertainties: Positive/feed side of relay coils Re12, Re13, Re14 is not traced on this sheet — only the negative/switch-contact side back to breakers Q1/Q4/Q5 is drawn; the coil's other supply side is INCOMPLETE per engineer rule and needs confirmation from an adjacent sheet or main panel schematic.

REED SUMP SW. and BY-PASS/REED SUMP SW. contacts: drawn symbol reads NC but the measured wiring shows NO — a direct CONFLICT on both the FWD and AFT crew head sump circuits; this changes whether the pump runs by default (float open) or only on float closure, and needs engineer confirmation before the auto-sump-pump logic is finalized.

Correspondence between the seven status taps (92-96, 97-101, BACKUP EM POWER, GMDSS BACKUP) and their exact downstream monitoring device/panel destination beyond the ALARM lamp on this PC CARD is not fully measured — the sheet shows them landing on a shared alarm loom but the ultimate annunciator/monitor identity is not established here (cross-reference to ONYX/monitoring sheet needed).

Negative/return side of all seven pump loads (AFT grey water, port/stbd aft guest sump, fwd/aft crew head sump, aft A/C sump) is not traced on this sheet past the pump symbol — presumed to return to a negative bus off-sheet but not drawn here.

EMERGENCY LTS SW Link (terminals 103-105, T/S E-57) continuing via MU4-12 to remote terminal strip T/S F
